classificationPolicy.CURRENT_WORKSPACE_EXACT: raw Graphify source_ref plus observed workspace binding
classificationPolicy.KNOWN_CANONICAL_ALIAS: unique normalized Graphify ref plus observed workspace binding
classificationPolicy.HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT: legacy date-like or .txt packet reference; bridge required
classificationPolicy.NON_CANONICAL_SCOPE: known nested/external scope; never current-workspace eligible
classificationPolicy.AMBIGUOUS: multiple Graphify candidates by basename; rejected
